title: Desktop Automation MCP application policy
description: Version-controlled policy format the server reads live via DESKTOP_AUTOMATION_POLICY_FILE. NOTE: protected_actions must be a subset of the allowed_actions set; this cross-field constraint is checked by policy_file.py. NOTE: expires_at must contain a numeric UTC offset (e.g. +03:00); bare 'Z' or offset-less date-time is invalid.

application.description: Permission record for a single Windows application.

executable_path.description: Allowed full executable file path (e.g. C:\Program Files\ruffle\bin\ruffle.exe). Cannot be empty.

title_patterns.description: Case-insensitive title glob patterns; at least one pattern is required (e.g. *Ruffle*).

allowed_actions.description: Actions explicitly allowed for this application. Exactly matches the server's KNOWN_ACTIONS set; unknown action names are rejected.

protected_actions.description: NOTE: drawn from the same enum as allowed_actions and must logically be a subset of allowed_actions. If the two conflict (the protected list contains an action not in the allowed list) the policy counts as invalid; this cross-validation is performed by tools/validate_policy.py.

safe_regions.description: Optional named screenshot permission regions. rect is a window-relative [left, top, right, bottom] coordinate; values are therefore zero or positive. A negative screen/monitor origin belongs to the P2 multi-monitor matrix and is never carried into the window-relative rect. Names must be unique at runtime validation.

screenshot_masks.description: Optional fixed mask rectangles. rect is a window-relative [left, top, right, bottom] coordinate and therefore cannot be negative; the portion intersecting the captured area is painted black.

max_screenshot_bytes.description: Upper byte limit for a single PNG response; 1 KiB..16 MiB.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry; ISO-8601 date-time with MANDATORY numeric UTC offset (e.g. 2027-01-01T00:00:00+03:00). Bare 'Z' or offset-less values are not accepted. An expired policy is rejected.
